pages.text: Variable, constant and literal items can hide their value for good.

Set $(l)Hide the value$() to "Yes, for good" in the dialog of the item before you save it. From then on, the dialog and the tooltip show $(1)***$(). You can still rename a variable item. Only the trash can button removes the value, and with it the hiding. Hidden items don't stack with items that are not hidden.

A process can use the value like any other. The parameter it fills shows $(1)***$() in the debugging tool. Hiding protects against people who look at your screen, not against the server: for secrets that must stay safe, use the vault of c0de/security.
$(1)FUNCTION login$(br)  PARAMETER password STRING$(br)BEGIN$(br)  CALL PRINT$(br)    PARAMETER value "Logged in" ;$(br)END FUNCTION$()
